name: Vaki, River
body:
River Vaki CR 7

An elderly human-looking woman stands in the middle of the river, her feet resting on the surface of the water.

XP 3,200
NG Medium outsider (native, water)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft., Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 13, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +7 natural)
hp 85 (10d10+30)
Fort +10, Ref +6, Will +11
DR 5/cold iron; Immunities bleed, mind-affecting effects, petrification, polymorph; Resist acid 10, electricity 10, fire 10; SR 15
Weaknesses water dependent

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 60 ft.
Melee 2 slams +13 (1d6+2)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks animate water, water mastery
Spell-Like Abilities (Cl 10th)

At will–fog cloud, water walk (self only)
3/day—dispel magic, quickened invisibility, water breathing
1/day—commune with nature

SQ magical mentor, water bond, water meld

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 16, Con 16, Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 19
Base Atk +10; CMB +12; CMD 25
Feats Alertness, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Quicken Spell-like Ability (invisibility), Weapon Focus (slam)
Skills Bluff +14, Diplomacy +14, Heal +9, Knowledge (arcana) +9, Knowledge (nature) +9, Knowledge (planes) +9, Perception +14, Sense Motive +14, Spellcraft +9, Stealth +13, Swim +12
Languages Aquan, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Animate Water (Sp)

A river vaki can animate water within 180 feet at will, controlling an amount up to the volume of a Medium creature. The water moves and acts as a single mass, appearing as a water elemental. It takes 1 full round for a mass of water to gather itself and rise up, after which it moves at a speed of 20 feet on land, swims with a speed of 90, and fights as a Medium water elemental (although it lacks the water elemental’s vortex and water mastery abilities). If the vaki that animated it terminates the animation, moves out of range, or is incapacitated, the watery mass immediately splashes to the ground wherever it is and returns to its normal state.

Magical Mentor (Su)

A river vaki can infuse mortals with bardic magic. As a full-round action, a river vaki can touch a creature and impart the magical spellcasting abilities of bards, causing the target creature to become a 1st level bard. River vaki only do this for aspiring bards who impress them with their talent. This gift is not freely given. The vaki may expect years of service in return.

River vaki can also use this ability to teach an existing bard any one bard spell of the GM’s choice that is of a level the bard can cast.

Water Bond (Su)

Once per day as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity, a river vaki can forge a bond with a feature of a river, such as a pool, falls, or rapids. A river vaki gains strength from the bond with this river feature. While within 300 yards of its bonded river feature, a river vaki gains a +1 insight bonus to Armor Class and a +1 racial bonus on saving throws (these bonuses are not included in the stats above).

Water Dependent (Su)

A river vaki is mystically bonded to its river feature and once bonded, must never stray more than 300 yards from it. Most river vakis choose a quite pool or secluded oxbow lake. Others choose a stretch of rapids or a waterfall. A river vaki who moves 300 yards beyond its bonded river feature must make a DC 15 Fortitude save each hour or become sickened.

Every hour thereafter, the river vaki must make a DC 15 Fortitude save to resist becoming nauseated for an hour.

A river vaki that is out of range of its bonded river feature for 24 hours takes 1d6 points of Constitution damage, and another 1d6 points of Constitution damage every day that follows— eventually, this separation kills the water vaki if it cannot find another river feature to bond with.

Water Meld (Su)

A river vaki can meld with its bonded river feature, similar to how the spell meld into stone functions. The River vaki can remain melded with its bonded river feature as long as she wishes.

Water Mastery (Ex)

A river vaki gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls if both it and its opponent are touching water. If the opponent or the river vaki is touching the ground, the river vaki takes a –4 penalty on attack and damage rolls. These modifiers apply to bull rush and overrun maneuvers, whether the river vaki is initiating or resisting these kinds of attacks.

ECOLOGY

Environment any aquatic (river) or Plane of Water
Organization solitary, pair, or group (3-8)
Treasure double standard

River vakis usually appear as elderly humans with grey hair, healthy skin, and eyes that shine with wisdom and kindness.

Some appear to be gnomes or elves, but these are also elderly.

According to folklore, river vaki are wealthy and keep abundant treasure hordes.

They are helpful and have been known to teach magic to aspiring young bards.

They also sometimes reach out to adventurers when they are in need themselves. A river vaki might ask adventures to help with any number of problems.

While river vaki are usually friendly and helpful, they do not tolerate undead, fire creatures, or anything evil. They are uncomfortable and irritated when such creatures are afoot.

Lost Atlanteans, Copyright 2024, Bloodstone Press; author Beth Jones
